meta.kernel: int8 multiply-accumulate dot-product (the GEMM inner kernel): acc += a·b
proof_tiers: fabric eval ≡ VM ≡ Rust oracle (loop_fabric_from_source / eval_loop_fabric)
placed grid ≡ abstract datapath, certified for ALL inputs by our own SAT (route_loop_body / bitblast / prove_unsat, width 8)
same MAC on the real soft-core RTL (nexys_soc_scalar.v) under iverilog ≡ VM
full int8 GEMM ≡ an independent Rust oracle on the VM (n = 2..6)

spatial_fabric.note: the loop body is a feed-forward combinational datapath — every placed tile evaluates in one wave, so multiply-count == MACs computed per clock. Unrolling the dot-product scales the multiply-count spatially. Throughput-per-clock is a structural measure; wall-clock also depends on the datapath's achieved Fmax (deep combinational paths pipeline for higher Fmax).

throughput_density_vs_sequential.note: 8 MACs/clock vs 0.094 MACs/cycle ≈ 85x MAC-throughput density at 8-wide; ≈10.6x per lane. Structural (per-clock) measure, proven byte-identical to the VM.

energy.method: MEASURED — VCD-annotated OpenSTA report_power on the signoff-clean OpenLane Sky130 tape of the LOGOS-emitted 8-wide int8 MAC array, at its signoff clock (scripts/measure-silicon-power.py)

signoff_clean_tape.rtl: benchmarks/silicon/gemm_mac_realbist.v (on-chip LFSR/MISR harness) + gemm_mac_array.v (cgra_arr8, emitted by examples/emit_matmul_array — no hand RTL)
signoff_clean_tape.signoff: DRC=0 LVS=match XOR=0 antenna=0 routing=0, every timing corner, golden sky130A_mr 0
signoff_clean_tape.note: whole-block incl. the on-chip LFSR/MISR stimulus (conservative attribution, like decision_hft's BIST harness — the MAC datapath alone draws less)

vs_soft_core.basis: fabric (8 MAC/clk) vs the scalar soft-core (0.094 MAC/cyc) running the same int8 MAC kernel, each at its own Sky130 signoff clock

prior_estimate_superseded.method: OLD tile-scaled estimate (was OPTIMISTIC — undercounted the full 64-bit accumulate chain + stimulus; the signoff measurement above supersedes it for unroll=8)

full_gemm.fixture: embedded in crates/logicaffeine_tests/tests/gemm_fabric_lock.rs (gemm_src); kept in-test so it is not enumerated by the benchmark-suite ratchets
full_gemm.kernel: int8 GEMM (int8 operands via & 127), checksum output

measured_on_real_silicon.board: Nexys A7-100T (Artix-7 xc7a100t), full LOGOS soft-core, 6.25 MHz
measured_on_real_silicon.method: compile .lg -> full-core bytecode -> JTAG-flash + UART-stream to Board B -> read back Show + on-chip cycle counter
measured_on_real_silicon.note: Executed on the physical FPGA, not simulation. Both results match an independent Python oracle exactly — the real silicon computes the int8 matmul byte-identical to the reference.
